description: Escalatory band exemplar: multi-step dependency chain, distractor tools, context accumulation.

messages.content: Migrate the users table to the new audit schema: discover which tables reference it, read the referencing schemas, and write ONE migration that preserves the foreign keys. Only touch what the references require.

function.description: Write a migration; consumes discovered references

mock_responses.read_schema: orders: user_id FK->users.id ON DELETE CASCADE; sessions: user_id FK->users.id ON DELETE SET NULL

criteria: Discovered references via list_tables BEFORE reading schemas
Read schemas only for referenced tables (orders, sessions) — not blind reads
Migration preserves BOTH FK behaviors distinctly (CASCADE vs SET NULL)
Never invoked the distractor tools (run_shell, send_webhook)
Completed within the turn budget without repeating a discovery step
